episodes.title: How I got out of the Kingston Polygamous Community | PART ONE
episodes.description:
🚨 PART 2 COMES OUT FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 25, 2026 🚨

At 16 years old, I left the polygamous cult I had been raised in.

My dad was the older brother of the cult’s leader, and I was his 97th child.

Part 1 touches on what happened during the first few weeks after I escaped and how I ultimately ended up being sent back to the cult by the police.

This is only the beginning of the story. There’s so much more to what happened after that.

Part 2 comes out Friday, September 25. 🤍
